label: Official IDAES Reversible SOFC in SOEC Mode
request: Build the official IDAES reversible solid-oxide-cell plant in SOEC mode with auxiliary boiler steam generation, air and fuel-side preparation, recycle, hydrogen compression, ASU and oxycombustion integration, HRSG heat recovery, condensation, and CO2 processing.
scope: Stoichiometric steam electrolysis and Faraday-law power balance at fixed voltage; no cell transport or integrated heat recovery model.
